SwiftLaTeX v20022022
Source: https://github.com/SwiftLaTeX/SwiftLaTeX/tree/v20022022
Release: https://github.com/SwiftLaTeX/SwiftLaTeX/releases/tag/v20022022

The vendored JavaScript and WebAssembly files are unmodified release assets.
swiftlatexxetex.fmt was generated by that XeTeX worker on 2026-09-18 from
the TeX distribution available to the CoFolio development environment, so
current ctex/expl3 packages remain compatible with the preloaded format.
See LICENSE in this directory.
